title: Market Day in Tenochtitlan
hook: Sixty thousand people traded here using chocolate as cash.

scenes.text: In the Aztec island capital of Tenochtitlan, the great market of Tlatelolco amazed Spanish conquistadors.

scenes.text: Over fifty thousand traders gathered daily under strict government inspectors who ensured fair weights.

scenes.text: There was no metal coinage. High-value transactions were paid using precious cacao beans and cotton cloaks.
